name: Modal Dialog Interception & Fail-Closed Safety
policy: Prefer blocked+capture over blind Yes/No. Auto-clicking Yes on Non-Fatal is strictly forbidden.

decision_table_rules.invariant: Auto-dismiss splash screen to unblock GUI initialization

decision_table_rules.match_condition: title contains 'select editor' or ctrl_id 1461 present
decision_table_rules.invariant: Auto-select IEC Structured Text radio (1461) and confirm with OK (1)

decision_table_rules.match_condition: text contains 'Non-Fatal Compilation Errors were found' or 'Do you wish to continue'
decision_table_rules.invariant: Auto-clicking Yes (ID 6) is strictly forbidden; capture telemetry and dismiss cleanly with No (ID 7)
Physical hardware download commands are unconditionally blocked fail-closed
Targeted project path enforcement; prevents overwriting baseline containers

decision_table_rules.match_condition: foreign pid or unrecognized dialog prompt
decision_table_rules.invariant: Never blindly click Yes/OK on unknown modals; fail closed and capture diagnostic telemetry
